timeline.text: How do you catch a scammer who's minted dozens of throwaway coins before?
My risk scorer only checked how concentrated the top holders were.
That let a serial token creator score the same as a clean, first-time launch, like trusting a repeat shoplifter as a first-time customer.
Now it pulls real holder and creator data from Jupiter's market API.
A wallet is vetoed outright the moment it crosses fifty of its own mints.
